Japan's (JPN) **Anthropic Usage Index is 1.91** for the period starting 2026-05-01. It ranks 32nd of 121 countries.

The index is a country's share of Claude usage divided by its share of the working-age population. A value of 1.0 is the global average, so 1.91 means Japan uses Claude about 91% more than its population alone would predict.

A few other figures from the same result, with the global average in brackets:
- **Work, personal and coursework split:** 47% / 47% / 6% (43% / 40% / 16%)
- **Augmentation vs automation:** 53% / 47% (51% / 49%)

This data describes how Claude is used, not jobs or the labor market. Source and method: https://www.anthropic.com/economic-index
